outcome.technical: Applied the P130.22-ywo patch (7 files). (1) ci.yml comment and CHANGELOG reworded (option taken: reword, not SHA-keyed group): a running main run is never cancelled, a queued one is replaced when a newer push queues behind it. (2) gate-parity _if_tier: a job if: is per-run only when it reduces to the guard terms (!cancelled(), needs.verified.outputs.run=='') optionally with inputs.tier=='release'; anything else is a problems row naming the job; guard-only jobs without a verify.sh call stay outside. New case sv12 (false, push-only, guard alone, guard+release term). (3) ci-verified: VOUCHING_EVENTS = workflow_dispatch/push; decide() refuses other events with a why naming the event; ask_github fetches jobs only for acceptable runs. New case cv18; cv1 style dispatch acceptance still green. (4) check-git-pipeline.py and test_gen_demo_manifest.py now name verify.sh's e2e and manifests slices; grep for ci.yml in both files returns nothing. (5) reproducing-ci-locally SKILL.md names sh tools/verify.sh --list. All named suites pass from the task tree; real gate-parity.py run exits 0.
outcome.descriptive: CI concurrency wording is true, the slice check cannot be fooled by a never-true or push-only job condition, and ci-verified no longer lets a pull_request run vouch for a SHA.
